methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
In this paper a semantic web based Linked Open
Data architecture is developed to update the sensed data into an LCI database.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Tool/data architecture for real-time LCI energy measurements; no EnPI or EnB measurement model is identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
So
here we present the development of an energy measurement device, its ability to push
sensed data into the cloud and the overall architecture of the semantic annotation
system that enriches the data from monitoring device for consumption by an LCA
system.

stage1.notes: EnBoX is a current-sensing device and cloud-linked LCI data architecture, not an energy baseline model despite its expanded name.
